entities.name: Cloudspire Racing Team

entities.description: Interplanar race won by Cloudspire in its first running.

events.summary: The Cloudspire Racing Team surprises fans by winning the first interplanar Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: This team surprised fans by winning the very first interplanar Ghirapur Grand Prix

events.summary: Chandra joins Cloudspire over the Aether Rangers, shocking the Avishkari public who expected her to join her mother Pia.
events.quote: Chandra's choice to join Cloudspire over the Aether Rangers sent shockwaves through the Avishkari public

events.summary: Chandra and Kolodin become co-captains for the second Grand Prix, with Kolodin working to integrate her.
events.quote: Kolodin, ever the team player, has worked to integrate her into his squad with as little friction as possible.
